rationale: PULP_DEV_BUILD, exported PUBLIC by pulp::platform from the build profile, compiles the development-only environment hooks (hot-reload watcher and PULP_RELOAD_LOGIC_PATH, environment-triggered SKP capture, the view hosts' dev reads) out of release builds, and ReloadableShell verifies its initial DSP image when the watcher is compiled out. Dev builds behave as before; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
